keySentence: She walked through the dark forest.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The forest was dark. She was a little scared. But she kept walking. She walked through the dark forest.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Red Riding Hood continued deeper into the forest. The trees were tall and blocked most of the sunlight. She walked through the dark forest feeling brave. Strange sounds came from behind the bushes. Her heart was beating fast but she thought of Grandmother. She held her basket tightly and walked on.
